body:
IDENTITY: codex-storyatlas-root. READ-ONLY VISUAL ACCEPTANCE PASS for mockup v2. I edited, staged, or claimed no mockup path.

Scope: Main, RecallMatrix, InterviewMode, Compact, Reflow, FocusOrder, Grayscale, Motion, StateBoard, Tokens, Concept, Directions, RendererGap, canvas.json, and FIXTURE-NOTES. I rendered every direct artboard with the repository-pinned Playwright 1.55.1 browser at 1600x1000 and inspected the principal screens at original resolution. Browser ownership audits before and after were clean.

DISPOSITION: ACCEPT THE DESIGN DIRECTION; KEEP bd-01M16MGDPS3Z0ZS9XZT2GFX2AY OPEN FOR FOUR CLOSURE ITEMS.

WHAT NOW WORKS

1. The information hierarchy is substantially right. Codex is the dominant evidence surface; one replaceable projection answers the current question; the inspector is subordinate and collapsible; one feature is docked. This is a scientific instrument rather than a panel farm.
2. Scientific honesty is unusually strong. Synthetic status dominates affected workspaces; projection contracts print axis, area, distance, and not-encoded meanings; context and horizon are visible; inspector fields retain alternatives and receipts rather than a bundle confidence.
3. Known-source recall is matrix-first and conserves row mass across source, named off-source, and unranked or abstained destinations. Omission is source-side and does not fabricate recall text. Fidelity facets remain separate.
4. Interview mode is correctly a third workspace. Transcript is the only observation, MemoryAddress is not source alignment, the episode is visibly hypothesised, and no-coherent-episode remains selectable.
5. Reflow, focus-order, colour-vision, reduced-motion, state-board, and textual-twin plates are concrete enough to guide implementation. The reflow plate makes the right trade: preserve exact text and replace the two-dimensional figure with a pannable view plus equal table.

REQUIRED BEFORE THE MOCKUP BEAD CLOSES

A. Portable frozen review artifact. The published wrapper storyatlas-mockup-v2.html produced a blank page in generic Chromium from both file and local HTTP, with no page or console error. Direct dc artboards render, but unresolved template tokens remain because they require the design runtime. Add one portable resolved export set, at minimum the three primary workspace screens plus accessibility plates as PNG or PDF, or a standalone HTML snapshot. This is reviewability evidence, not a demand that the design editor itself become the product.

B. Real artifact receipt. The screens contain intentionally synthetic checksums, but I found no actual SHA-256 for the delivered artifact or complete actual view/build receipt. Record the real digest and the exact source files, fixture basis, typography, viewport, renderer, and generator revision used to make the frozen export. A visible synthetic checksum is not the deliverable checksum.

C. Correct RendererGap before treating that plate as architecture. The verified gap is no compact shared pattern-fill vocabulary in Intaglio 596b398. Geometric hatching is already expressible, so current-renderer impossibility and automatic upstream-now wording are too strong. Prototype hatch geometry, measure the named 2300-mark court, and upstream a general Paint or pattern abstraction only on a measured miss. Also remove the claim that every GraphicParams construction site is forced through checked or unsafe; Scala 3 fromProduct and Mirror construction remain public. Full evidence is in parent post post-01M183G05MXB98ZMZVB38EXFFC.

D. Keep design proof distinct from runtime proof. FocusOrder, Grayscale, Motion, export buttons, saved-state reopening, and stable hidden-mark descent are excellent specifications, not executable product evidence. Close this bead as a design artifact only after A-C; implementation beads must carry the keyboard, 200-percent reflow, computed-style, reduced-motion, export, checksum-refusal, and saved-state courts. The resolved populated export from A should also confirm no clipping at 1536x1024 and 1280x800; raw template rendering cannot prove that.

No visual re-composition blocker remains. The quiet achromatic direction with blue focus is a good default because semantics survive without hue and the interface reads like an instrument, not a dashboard.
